contract: Pure functions over a skill folder given as data and over a checked recipe package: read/4 checks the operands, the paths and the fixed folder bounds, splits SKILL.md at its frontmatter lines, scans and reads the frontmatter with the pinned YAML reader and gives the skill entry of a recipe package and the other files of the folder; source/2 gives the one pinned_skill tool-registry source of the skills of a package, with the tools load_skill and read_skill_file; load/2 gives the declaration payload with the body of one skill byte for byte and no listing; read_file/3 gives one other file of a skill as marked untrusted content; each refusal is a fixed reason that holds no path, file byte, frontmatter value or body.
limits: Reads no file system and stores nothing; the caller holds the bytes, and that the files belong to the pinned package version is a host Need. Trust is the host's pin of the package: a matching identity authenticates nobody, and the other files are not in the package identity.

read/4 checks nothing of the name, the version, the tools or the frontmatter fields; Elzoo.RecipePackage.decode/1 of the package that holds the entry does that, and malformed skills are refused there, not at load. The bounds of the package and of the agent loop are theirs and are not checked again.

No Markdown is parsed and no script is read as code, compiled, evaluated or run; no option of the YAML reader is set. The media type is text/plain or application/octet-stream, never guessed from the path.

A load lists no tool: the declared tools of a skill are package declarations only, and allowed-tools grants nothing. RC-67 'a load that would pass 64 tools gives the instructions and the named refusal' is not met; listing the tools of a skill needs a change of workflow/agent-loop and is its own later task.

RC-67 'a skill whose declared tool is not permitted for the principal' is met in part: the instructions load whatever the declared tools are (agent_loop_accepts); the refusal at use is the work of the engine and the registry. RC-67 'scripts are stored and read, never executed' is met in part: this Piece reads and never executes; storing is a host Need.

RC-67 'a changed skill version does not change a running Run' is met in part: it is workflow/version-pin and the host's pin; here it is shown only by pure functions over the package given (pinned_version_answers). RC-67 'with the harness of RC-66, a load survives a restart and is not done again' is met in part: it is shown by folding the agent loop again over a cut trace, not with the harness.

A file read is not tied to a loaded skill. The frontmatter scan is not a YAML reader and refuses some texts that are not aliases: a continuation line of a plain or quoted scalar that begins with & or *; a & or * after ': ' inside a trailing comment; a << inside quoted text of a flow collection or in a comment of one; a plain value that holds ': *'; a continuation line of a plain scalar that begins with '? '. A & or * inside quoted text of a flow collection is literal and is accepted. An explicit key '? ' is refused as invalid_yaml. After the closing quote of a quoted scalar only blanks, the line end, a comment or ':' and a blank may follow (in a flow region also ',', ']', '}' and ':'); every other byte is invalid_yaml, and a quoted scalar of a block region that does not end on its line is invalid_yaml. A continuation line of a plain scalar that begins with a quote follows the same rule. A flow collection stays open over its lines, at any indentation, until its brackets close. A byte-order mark is refused as missing_frontmatter.

The scan does not refuse a duplicate key below the top level, a duplicate in a top level written in flow style or with ? keys, or two double-quoted keys that are equal only after their escapes are decoded: the pinned reader keeps the first value.

The test scan_agrees_with_the_reader calls :yamerl_parser.string/2 of the pinned yamerl in test files only, with the option token_fun that the pinned docs do not expand; no file of lib/ names it. It is a finite sample, not a proof that the scan matches the reader.
Finite named scenarios, not a universal proof.

grounding.claim: Named groups skill_md_split (LF and CR LF files, the closing line rules, a byte-order mark, frontmatter of exactly 16,384 bytes and one more, invalid UTF-8, missing SKILL.md, empty body, blank and non-map frontmatter), yaml_refusals (each case of the group: an anchor, an alias, a tag, a flow region with its tokens (an anchor or alias after a colon, a comma, a closing bracket, a comment or a tag, quotes, comments and line breaks), an explicit key '? ' at a line start, after '- ' and in a flow region, the key <<, a block region ended at an equal indentation, texts that are not aliases, texts with a ? that is not an indicator, a duplicate top-level key, a tab indentation, tabs as separation, a document marker, a lone CR, blank and non-map frontmatter, unreadable YAML that runs nothing; with the extra cases of region and key rules) and folder_bounds_and_paths (each invalid path, the path, file, count and folder bounds on both sides, each operand rule and the order of the checks) are literal folders given to read/4; package_checks_fields puts each entry of read/4 into the checked example package of domain/recipe-package and shows the package result of decode/1 for each case; pinned_skill_source (the literal source map, the registry snapshot and aliases, a description of 1,024 four-byte code points whole in the input schema, no_skills, invalid_input, no allowed-tools text and no tool identity in the source), load_gives_declaration (the literal payload for each skill, each refusal in its order), file_read_is_marked_content (text, binary and empty files as marked content, ToolResultLimit.decide/3 storing 2,000 bytes and passing 1,000 bytes, a body text refused as unmarked, each refusal of read_file/3 in its order), scripts_never_run (script bytes unchanged and no sentinel file and no persistent_term after read/4 and read_file/3), agent_loop_accepts (AgentLoop.new/1 and step/3 folded over a recorded trace: the load action, the accepted declaration with the body in the system message outside every marked block, already_loaded, instructions_over_bound, a file read as a marked block, a refused unknown_skill outcome, the same tools before and after a load of a skill with tools and allowed-tools, and the trace cut after each input and folded again) and pinned_version_answers (P1 answers after P2 exists; the identities differ) are given over the same helpers; examples/skill.exs is run from the test. Negative controls, each a temporary edit that was reverted: leaving the listing member out of the load payload fails agent_loop_accepts with the notice 'declaration refused: invalid_declaration'; removing case 1 of pass 3 (a node text that begins with & or *) fails yaml_refusals case 2.1. Dropping '? ' as an indicator again fails yaml_refusals case 2.17; ignoring the end of a tag in the flow scan fails cases 2.17 and 2.19; never opening a quoted scalar in the flow scan fails case 2.20. Finite scenarios, not a universal proof. After a closing quote: yaml_refusals cases 2.23 and 2.24 (the four texts of the rule, the rows of the second review, anchors glued on to a closing quote, a quoted scalar that does not end on its line, a comment without a blank, and the texts that stay accepted). Group scan_agrees_with_the_reader (test/elzoo/skill_differential_test.exs): a positive control first (the oracle reports an anchor, an alias, a tag outside the list, a key << and an explicit key in fixed texts and none in a plain map), then, with the seeds {1, 2, 3} and {4, 5, 6} of :rand exsss, 200,000 random texts of 1 to 24 bytes over the whole alphabet, 200,000 over a dense alphabet and every text of up to 6 bytes over a 9 symbol alphabet (1,511,104 texts without a line that starts with ---, 54,313 accepted, 0 disagreements in the full run, which is ELZOO_SCAN_DIFFERENTIAL=full mix test on that file; the default run is a seeded sample of 151,109 texts), where a disagreement is a forbidden token in the token stream of an accepted text, and an oracle that raises counts as a refusal only when YamlElixir.read_from_string/2 also gives an error. A finite sample, not a proof. Negative controls, each a temporary edit that was reverted: any byte after a closing quote accepted again fails cases 2.23 and 2.24 and the sample finds the glued anchors; an oracle that records no token fails the positive control.
Pinned yaml_elixir 2.12.2 read_from_string/2 with the option list [] gives {:ok, term} or {:error, error} and raises on no input that ELZ-176 recorded; only that call is used.

Pinned yamerl 0.10.0 is the parser; the behaviours that ELZ-176 recorded in docs/dependencies.md (a tab inside a block scalar, !!binary, an unknown tag, an unterminated flow collection) hold as recorded there; no yamerl parameter is set.

Pinned yamerl 0.10.0 yamerl_parser:string/2 is exported and documented; its option token_fun (a fun that receives each token record in order) is defined in an internal header, not expanded in the docs. Only the test scan_agrees_with_the_reader calls it, matches the token records yamerl_anchor, yamerl_alias, yamerl_tag, yamerl_scalar, yamerl_collection_start and yamerl_mapping_key, and opens with a positive control that fails when the oracle sees none of them.

Pinned Elixir binary pattern matching, :binary.split/2, String.valid?/1 and String.replace/3 give the byte checks; the Contracts of domain/recipe-package (checked package, encode/1), workflow/untrusted-content (decode/1 and encode/1 make the marked map), workflow/tool-registry (snapshot/1 and tools/1 accept the source), workflow/tool-result-limit (decide/3 stores or passes a marked file result and refuses a body as unmarked) and workflow/agent-loop (the declaration form, already_loaded and instructions_over_bound, a load applied whole) are used unchanged.

The host puts each entry of read/4 into the recipe package and publishes only a package that RecipePackage.decode/1 accepts, pins the package of a Run (workflow/version-pin) and gives source/2, load/2 and read_file/3 that pinned package and the files of the same version, stores the skill files, maps the tool {:adapter, id, "load_skill"} to load/2 and {:adapter, id, "read_skill_file"} to read_file/3 with {:ok, payload} as a completed outcome under elzoo.agent-loop.tool-result version 1 and {:error, reason} as a refused outcome with the payload {"reason": reason}, keeps skill descriptions short enough for the state bound of the agent loop, leaves the yamerl parameter node_mods at [] and starts the yamerl application.

telemetry.contract: Pure functions over intrinsic operands and fixed bounds; no logs or telemetry emitted.

config.contract: Pure functions over intrinsic operands and fixed bounds; no selectable settings.

control.contract: Pure functions over intrinsic operands and fixed bounds; no process or lifecycle.
